items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The writers were Sammy Nestico, and the one before him… he wasn’t writing that much when I get in the band.

ctx.x: Who were the principal writers at that point?
The writers were Sammy Nestico, and the one before him… he wasn’t writing that much when I get in the band. His stuff was already in the book.
So it was like the second testament band?
